name: Vermilion
description: Falk's airship, crushed by a nightmare snake.

timeline.summary: Abda is fatally struck by a projectile from the Vermilion while assisting Brin.
timeline.quote: Abda was fatally struck by a projectile fired from the skyship Vermilion

citation.text: "Abda and Rigi", section "Battle at the Ozolith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rigi, affected by the Ozolith's pulse, destroys the hunter's longboat and helps bring down the Vermilion, dying in the process.
timeline.quote: Rigi destroyed the hunter's longboat and helped bring down the Vermilion by damaging its gasbag

citation.text: "Abda and Rigi", section "Battle at the Ozolith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Ozolith pulses and the nightmares turn on the hunters; the great snake drags the skyship Vermilion down while Barrow and Zeph survive.
timeline.quote: The great snake coiled around Vermilion, dragging it down despite the crew's frantic attempts to flee.

citation.text: "Barrow and Zeph", section "Battle at the Ozolith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A nightmare snake brings down the Vermilion, killing Rigi, Falk and Johannes; Jirina sees Lukka in the Ozolith and Leori carries her away.
timeline.quote: while the Vermillion crashed to the ground, killing Rigi, Falk, and Johannes
